fixture.summary: A claim takes an instance in queued: its lease, its budget reservation, and a move to running, in one write. claimNext claims the first the caller can, highest priority first, then oldest first, matching topic, trying at most 100. An instance is not claimed while it is exhausted (Retries), over its budget, here or in an enclosing scope (Budget), at 3 lease expiries or assigned to another principal.

claim.useWhen: Use to claim this Job when you know its id: it must be in queued.
claim.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find work; call claimNext.
claim.success: Returns id, token, expiresAt and heartbeatMs; the status is running. Present the token as preconditions {"Lease": {"token": n}} on each write and heartbeat at least every heartbeatMs.

errors.commonCorrection: None now: only an instance in queued is claimed. Call claimNext for work that is.

claimNext.useWhen: Use as a worker to take the next Job to work on, highest priority first, then oldest first. match filters on topic, each a value or a list of values. assignedOnly takes only work assigned to you.
claimNext.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to count the work waiting; call countClaimable.
claimNext.success: Returns claimed: id, token, expiresAt and heartbeatMs, or null when nothing is claimable now. Present the token as preconditions {"Lease": {"token": n}} on each write.

countClaimable.useWhen: Use to count the work claimNext would try for you, a signal to scale workers on; it claims nothing.

refresh.useWhen: Use only to recompute Queue's copies of the instance's facts; Queue invokes it itself when a blocker, a budget scope or a pinned link's target changes.

acquire.doNotUseWhen: Do not use: on Job the lease is taken by claim or claimNext.
